title: Round 10 (v10): final confirmation — (G) unseal G2F 2024 as a third external year; (W) second-crop forward validation on CIMMYT ESWYT with a same-test-set protocol contrast
status: FROZEN before any 2024 yield value is read (only file headers and row counts were inspected: 7_Testing_Observed_Values.csv = Env,Hybrid,Yield_Mg_ha, 9,486 rows, 23 envs) and before any ESWYT model is fitted (only per-nursery line/env counts were inspected).
compute: amax only, under <server>/egp_gxe; <= 48 threads total; all folds of a setting on one machine

tuning.primary: P3 (grouped inner CV: leave-one-training-year-out for G2F, leave-one-training-nursery-out for ESWYT)
tuning.reported: P1 (most recent training year / nursery as validation) and P2 (test-set oracle, audit only)
tuning.hgb: learning_rate 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, min_samples_leaf 200, random_state 20260928, n_iter in {50,100,200,400,800} by the same inner folds

part_G_G2F_2024.data: train = all 2014-2023 plots of the 2025 release; test = <server>/egp_gxe/data/g2f_2025/Testing_data_SEALED/7_Testing_Observed_Values.csv (env x hybrid means); 2024 weather/meta/EC from the same folder; test env inclusion >= 30 genotyped hybrids
part_G_G2F_2024.models: MG_2k, MG_98k (dense dosages built from the repaired 437k inbred VCF as in R9; hybrids whose parents are missing from the VCF are excluded from the 98k contrast only, with coverage reported; if < 80% of 2024 test records are buildable the 98k contrast is reported without a gate), D_noEC(MG_2k), D_full(MG_2k)
part_G_G2F_2024.metric: within-env Pearson over test envs; for the pooled external set EXT3 = 2022 + 2023 (from R9, re-scored from saved per-env predictions, not refit) + 2024
part_G_G2F_2024.uncertainty: env bootstrap stratified by year (2000, seed 20260928) and the per-year signs; year-level uncertainty is acknowledged as not captured by env resampling

G1_enhancements_external.USEFUL: pooled EXT3 Delta >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0 AND Delta > 0 in >= 2 of 3 years
G1_enhancements_external.family_claim: C_final_no_external_gain holds if no contrast is USEFUL

G2_EC_increment.CONFIRMED: pooled EXT3 >= 0.005 with CI lower > 0 AND > 0 in >= 2 of 3 years

G3_window_search_leak.setting: 2024 alone and pooled EXT3 (2022-2023 re-scored from R9)

part_G_G2F_2024.G4_tuning_audit: descriptive: P2-P3 and P1-P3 per year and pooled for every model

part_W_ESWYT.data: <server>/egp_gxe/data/eswyt (Juliana et al. 2020, ESWYT 24-37, line x environment BLUEs of yield; env = nursery x location; 9,110 markers after the das_gxe_go_gate QC; no weather available, so no EC models)
part_W_ESWYT.test_set: all envs of nurseries 34, 35, 36, 37 with >= 30 genotyped lines

protocols.FORWARD: for test nursery k, train on nurseries 24..k-1
protocols.INTERNAL_LONO: for test nursery k, train on all other nurseries 24..37 except k (future nurseries included)

models.MG: ridge on marker dosages (record level, env-centred yield)
models.D_noEC: two-stage: MG at its P3 lambda, then HGB on cross-fitted residuals with PC1..30 of the markers as features

W1_protocol_overstatement.CONFIRMED: >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0 (env bootstrap stratified by nursery)

W2_forward_gain.report: mean, CI, per-nursery signs; USEFUL if >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0 and positive in >= 3 of 4 nurseries

part_W_ESWYT.W4_tuning_audit: descriptive: P2-P3 and P1-P3 under both protocols

paper_level.C_THESIS_SUPPORTED: G1 family claim holds AND W1 CONFIRMED

reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
2024 data are read only inside part G code paths after this file is frozen
